Complete options.c controls, one target at a time, actual Ninja compiler/flags and basename held fixed. Each function: 55 compiles including six full-ELF-identical baseline controls; 46 unique changed source files. Three second-matrix reverse_and labels had a failed text-replacement and source-equal duplicates, so are NOT counted as source experiments. The later reverse_real labels really reversed both AND operands and were compiled.
A: add `u8* base;` and at have_index `base = gPlayers;` before selected-ID load; loop `u8* rec = base + p * PREC_STRIDE;`: 100/100,11 words. B: add `s32 selected;`, `selected = crystal_order[H_hint_index]; bit = 1 << selected;` keeping search id separate:100/100,13 words; A+B16. Existing unused `s32 off;` removal with B restores40-byte frame and8 words; A+B with off removal11. The five extra frame words are stwu/stmw/lmw/lwz/addi at0xc,0x10,0x17c,0x180,0x184, not scheduling progress.
C: move bit/p/base/selected declarations into a C89 block at have_index, separately and joint;100/100,8/11/16 depending same identity/frame classes. D: assign base after selected ID but before bit:11; after bit:8. E: inline `bit = 1 << crystal_order[H_hint_index];`:8, with A11; block initialized `u8* base = gPlayers; u32 bit = 1 << crystal_order[H_hint_index];`:11. F: reverse `(bit & *(u16*)(...))` into `(*(u16*)(...) & bit)` on both independent mask reads:8, with named base11, with inlined bit+base11. G: `1U << id`, `unsigned int bit`, `s32 bit`, `int bit`, and `int selected` with unused off removed:8. H: `Player* rec = &((Player*)gPlayers)[p]; rec->char_save[rec->character].FIELD` for both masks:8; named `Player* players; players = (Player*)gPlayers;` before ID and `rec = &players[p]`:11. Same typed base retaining raw offsetof fields:11. Assign typed players in for initializer after mask:8. No shared header edits.
I: `int p`, `int pass`, `int id`, or all scalar s32 locals as int:8; all-int plus A11. J: `for (bit = 1 << id, p = 0; p < 4; p++)`:8, plus A11. K: search-body `s32 id = crystal_order[i];` replaces root id, and final bit expression directly loads crystal_order:8; A11. L: reuse genuine search-index `i` for the subsequent player loop, remove p declaration, `for (i = 0; i < 4; i++)` with `i * PREC_STRIDE`:8; A11. K+L8; K+L+A11. Selected-ID in now-dead `i` (`i = crystal_order[H_hint_index]; bit = 1 << i;`)8; A11. M: restructure reset early-return into `if (advance == 0) { reset; } else { selection and player loop; }`:8; with A11; separate selected/off removal8; joint11. N: assign base on BOTH incoming CFG paths before have_index (before normal H_hint_index=i store and before fallback goto), use base in loop:104/100,49 words and later sibling offset changes; rejected, not a same-count recolor. H is boss/legend and FIELD is boss_attempt1/2 or level_masks[2]/[3] respectively.
